title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #11

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah is number 112 in the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. Al-Falaq
   D. Al-Masad

2. What does it mean to "emulate" the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Copy his good example
   B. Fear him
   C. Forget his words
   D. Argue with him

3. Which of these is a good time to use the siwak? (1 mark)
   A. Only in winter
   B. Never
   C. Before wudhu and prayer
   D. Only at weddings

4. What should you do before playing a sport? (1 mark)
   A. Skip water
   B. Sleep
   C. Warm up and drink water
   D. Eat a huge meal

5. How does physical fitness help worship? (1 mark)
   A. It removes the need to pray
   B. It makes standing, bowing and fasting easier
   C. It replaces zakat
   D. It makes prayer shorter

6. Ar-Rahman's mercy is (1 mark)
   A. Only for Muslims in Kenya
   B. Only for adults
   C. Only for the rich
   D. For all creation

7. Which verse teaches that nothing is like Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 42:11
   B. Qur'an 112:1
   C. Qur'an 110:1
   D. Qur'an 1:1

8. What is a good manner of making dua? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Never ask
   C. Ask only for toys
   D. Begin with praise and end with Amin

9. Which is true about angels? (1 mark)
   A. They are honoured servants of Allah
   B. They are humans
   C. They are jinn
   D. They are gods

10. Which prophet helped his father to build the Kaaba? (1 mark)
   A. Idris
   B. Ismail
   C. Hud
   D. Yunus

11. What does "najasa" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A food
   C. An impurity
   D. A journey

12. What did the Prophet say about purity? (1 mark)
   A. It is a game
   B. It is half of faith
   C. It is only for adults
   D. It is not important

13. Which verse says Allah sends down pure water from the sky? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 1:1
   B. Qur'an 112:1
   C. Qur'an 25:48
   D. Qur'an 110:1

14. How far are the arms washed? (1 mark)
   A. Only the wrist
   B. Up to the shoulder
   C. Only the palm
   D. Up to and including the elbows

15. What should a traveller do if unable to know the Qibla exactly? (1 mark)
   A. Try their best and Allah accepts it
   B. Ask no one
   C. Never pray
   D. Wait a year

16. Which is the correct order in one rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Fatiha, ruku, rising, sujud, sitting, sujud
   B. Sitting, standing, bowing
   C. Ruku, Fatiha, sujud
   D. Sujud, ruku, Fatiha

17. What is takbiratul ihram? (1 mark)
   A. Reciting Fatiha
   B. Saying "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer
   C. Saying salaam
   D. Bowing

18. Which animal do people in northern Kenya commonly use to carry loads? (1 mark)
   A. Camel
   B. Monkey
   C. Zebra
   D. Hippo

19. Which of these is one of Allah's creatures? (1 mark)
   A. A phone
   B. A chair
   C. A goat
   D. A stone wall

20. What does "destitute" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A rich person
   B. A farmer
   C. A person who has nothing to live on
   D. A teacher

21. Which prophet ate from the work of his hands? (1 mark)
   A. Yunus
   B. Nuh
   C. Hud
   D. Dawud

22. Which of these shows love from parents? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring
   B. Listening and praising good behaviour
   C. Comparing children
   D. Shouting all day

23. Which benefit comes when parents fulfil their duties? (1 mark)
   A. No benefit
   B. Children grow safe and well-behaved
   C. Children become unhappy
   D. Families become weak

24. What can children do for parents who have died? (1 mark)
   A. Sell their things
   B. Forget them
   C. Complain
   D. Make dua for them

25. Even if parents command wrong, what should we do? (1 mark)
   A. Still treat them kindly in worldly matters
   B. Leave home
   C. Insult them
   D. Ignore them

26. Why do we respect older relatives? (1 mark)
   A. They are noisy
   B. They are strong
   C. They are rich
   D. They have experience and wisdom

27. What is the extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Only parents
   B. Relatives beyond parents and siblings
   C. Only neighbours
   D. Only friends

28. Which surah contains the first five verses revealed? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Fatiha
   B. Al-Alaq
   C. An-Nasr
   D. Al-Ikhlas

29. What does "R.A." stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Peace be upon him
   B. Read Allah
   C. Rest at once
   D. May Allah be pleased with him or her

30. What does "As-Siddiq" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The old one
   B. The fast one
   C. The truthful one who believes
   D. The rich one

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. What can a person say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (2 marks)

32. Role-play plan: Write a short scene showing a parent fulfilling one obligation and the child's thanks. (5 marks)

33. Explain how a Grade 4 child can apply the command "Iqra". (4 marks)

34. Explain the role of Abu Bakr (R.A.) in the growth of Islam. (4 marks)

35. What is a pillar of swalah? (2 marks)

36. Write the six pillars of Iman and put a mark next to the one studied in this lesson. (4 marks)

37. State three virtues the Prophet showed in Taif. (3 marks)

38. State the duties of Malakul Maut and of Raqib and Atid. (2 marks)

39. Write the pillars of swalah from ruku up to taslim. (5 marks)

40. Write the meaning of the first two verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (2 marks)

41. Explain why parents should be fair among their children. (3 marks)

42. Halima made wudhu for Fajr. Later she took a short nap sitting up and then passed wind. Is her wudhu valid? Explain. (4 marks)

43. State four features of the Islamic code of dressing. (4 marks)

44. What happened to the woman who did not feed her cat? (3 marks)

45. Describe how to find the Qibla using the sun in Kenya. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Al-Ikhlas
   Al-Ikhlas is surah 112, Al-Falaq 113 and An-Naas 114.

2. A — Copy his good example
   To emulate is to follow an example.

3. C — Before wudhu and prayer
   The Prophet encouraged it before prayers.

4. C — Warm up and drink water
   Warm-up prevents injuries.

5. B — It makes standing, bowing and fasting easier
   A healthy body helps us do our duties.

6. D — For all creation
   It covers believers and non-believers, people and animals.

7. A — Qur'an 42:11
   It says there is nothing like Him and He is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

8. D — Begin with praise and end with Amin
   Dua begins with praise.

9. A — They are honoured servants of Allah
   Angels are creations of light.

10. B — Ismail
   Ismail and Ibrahim raised the foundations.

11. C — An impurity
   Najasaat are impure things.

12. B — It is half of faith
   Recorded by Muslim.

13. C — Qur'an 25:48
   Surah Al-Furqan 25:48.

14. D — Up to and including the elbows
   Qur'an 5:6 says to the elbows.

15. A — Try their best and Allah accepts it
   Allah does not burden beyond ability.

16. A — Fatiha, ruku, rising, sujud, sitting, sujud
   Tartib means this order.

17. B — Saying "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer
   It starts the prayer.

18. A — Camel
   Camels carry loads in dry areas.

19. C — A goat
   Animals are living creatures of Allah.

20. C — A person who has nothing to live on
   Destitute means very poor.

21. D — Dawud
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari.

22. B — Listening and praising good behaviour
   Love is shown by care.

23. B — Children grow safe and well-behaved
   Strong families.

24. D — Make dua for them
   A righteous child's dua benefits them.

25. A — Still treat them kindly in worldly matters
   Qur'an 31:15.

26. D — They have experience and wisdom
   Elders deserve respect.

27. B — Relatives beyond parents and siblings
   Grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins.

28. B — Al-Alaq
   Surah 96.

29. D — May Allah be pleased with him or her
   Radiyallahu anhu.

30. C — The truthful one who believes
   Abu Bakr's title.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: "Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu" meaning "In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for the meaning.

32. (5 marks)
   Answer: A parent helps with homework and the child says thank you and promises to do well. Award for a clear obligation, a clear action and an expression of thanks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the obligation, 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for thanks, 2 marks for clarity.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read and study daily, ask teachers questions, use safe sources to learn, share knowledge with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four ways.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: He believed at once, invited others, spent his wealth freeing believers, and was the Prophet's companion in the cave.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four roles.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: A part of the prayer which must be done for it to be valid.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for part and 1 mark for validity.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Belief in Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day and destiny. Angels are the one studied.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for every two pillars named, 1 mark for identifying angels.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Patience, tolerance, perseverance, mercy, trust in Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Malakul Maut takes souls at death. Raqib and Atid record our deeds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

39. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ruku, rising from ruku, sujud, sitting between the sujud, last sitting, tashahhud, blessings on the Prophet, taslim.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each two correct pillars up to 4 and 1 mark for correct order.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Read in the name of your Lord who created; He created man from a clinging clot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet told parents to fear Allah and be fair among children. Favouring one causes jealousy and hurt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for jealousy, 1 mark for fairness.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Her nap sitting up did not break wudhu, but passing wind did. So her wudhu is broken and she must make it again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the nap, 1 mark for wind, 1 mark for broken, 1 mark for making wudhu again.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Cover the awrah, loose and not see-through, clean and neat, not for showing off, no rude words or pictures.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: She tied the cat and did not feed it or let it find food. She was punished because of this. It teaches us that cruelty to animals is a sin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for the punishment, 1 mark for the lesson.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stretch the right arm towards the sunrise, which is east, and face forward, which is roughly north. Confirm with a compass or mosque.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the right arm to east, 1 mark for facing north, 1 mark for checking.
